items.headline: Sensex recovers to close 107 points higher at 81,106.65; Nifty at 25,044.65 as PSU banks jump 3%
items.summary: Indices bounced from steep intraday losses; decliners outnumbered gainers. Resumes gains after the flat Muhurat session; markets shut on 10 November. Consolidating near eight-month highs.
items.rationale: Public-sector bank buying and cheaper oil support the index, but weak breadth signals fatigue after an 8% rally.

items.headline: Brent settles 5.85% lower at $92.57 and drops more than $7 after settlement, lowest since late August
items.summary: WTI fell to $86.85. The US president said new strikes are highly unlikely while talks progress. Extends last week's 16% slide; analysts see $90 as a floor without a deal. Easing.
items.rationale: Oil near $90 sharply lowers India's import bill, subsidy burden and inflation outlook, supporting the rupee and bonds.

items.headline: Qatari interim proposal would lift the US blockade and free $8 billion of Iranian funds, reports say
items.summary: Neither side has confirmed terms; the US secretary of state says no breakthrough is near and Iran insists on seven conditions. Hormuz traffic fell to about 5 vessels a day over the weekend. Diplomacy advancing slowly.
items.rationale: An interim deal would reopen Hormuz and cut India's energy and freight costs sharply; failure would revive oil risk.

items.headline: Rupee rises 5 paise to 93.93 per dollar after touching a six-month high of 93.69
items.summary: State-run banks' dollar buying capped gains from lower crude and foreign inflows. Fourth straight gain. Strengthening.
items.rationale: A firmer rupee eases imported inflation; central bank dollar buying signals a preference to rebuild reserves.

items.headline: Foreign investors buy a net ₹7,212 crore; domestic funds sell ₹7,173 crore (provisional)
items.summary: Eighth session of foreign buying after about ₹45,960 crore in the week to 6 November. Domestic funds keep selling into the rally. Ongoing.
items.rationale: Steady foreign inflows support large caps and the rupee, offsetting domestic profit-taking.

items.headline: US imposes tariffs of up to 233% on Indian solar panels
items.summary: Duties topping 100% hit Indian solar exports to the US. New; comes as India–US trade talks continue.
items.rationale: Steep duties shut a key export market for Indian solar makers, pressuring capacity built for the US and weighing on the trade outlook.

items.headline: India opens an anti-dumping probe into aluminium imports from China, Malaysia, Vietnam and Thailand
items.summary: Follows other recent trade-remedy actions against Chinese imports. New.
items.rationale: Potential duties would protect domestic aluminium producers' prices and margins, while raising costs for downstream users.

items.headline: October CPI inflation expected near 6%, up from 5.54% in September, on food prices
items.summary: Edible oil, tomatoes and pulses show entrenched rises; data due 12 November ahead of the December RBI meeting. Escalating food inflation.
items.rationale: Higher inflation keeps pressure on the RBI to stay tight, limiting relief for bonds and rate-sensitive sectors despite cheaper oil.

items.headline: India offers to help restore Black Sea grain exports as the PM and Ukraine's president discuss peace
items.summary: Ukraine says India is ready to mediate food corridors; Black Sea cargo traffic is down 37%. Builds on earlier corridor proposals.
items.rationale: Restored Black Sea grain and edible oil flows would ease world food prices and India's food inflation.
